name: Galpos II
description: Galpos II was a planet home to a nest of Thalassian slavers that was located in the Galpos system in the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square S-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid. The 291st Legion cleared out the enslavers with the aid of the newly released AT-DPs.
lead_paragraphs: Galpos II was a planet home to a nest of Thalassian slavers that was located in the Galpos system in the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square S-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid. The 291st Legion cleared out the enslavers with the aid of the newly released AT-DPs.
